description: Use when: what tokens just launched on Base + BNB + Solana, and are they risky? Newest launches (four.meme, PancakeSwap, pump.fun...), up to 20 per chain, risk-checked at request time. Base/BNB: verified source, proxy, owner type, mint/pause/blacklist/fee. Solana: mint/freeze authority, mutable metadata, Token-2022 extensions, holders, curve progress. All: copycat flags (USDC, ETH, SOL...). Plus age, liquidity, FDV, 1h buys/sells. Data: GeckoTerminal. Heuristics, not an audit. Costs $0.02.
name: launch_feed
